operation: Select full-region paired rows; join matching PDF off/on summary rows. Preserve source numeric strings. No new numerical aggregation.

units.smape: percent; paired delta in percentage points
units.trmae: unitless local pair diagnostic; static empty

columns.name: condition
columns.definition: Canonical main-condition ID, copied from paired-differences.csv.

columns.name: scenario
columns.definition: Original scenario label, copied from paired-differences.csv.

columns.name: phase
columns.definition: Original sparse phase label: static-final or frame-32/frame-48/frame-96.

columns.name: representative_frame
columns.definition: 128 for static-final; otherwise numeric frame suffix of phase.

columns.name: local_temporal_pair
columns.definition: Empty for static; previous->current for 31->32,47->48,95->96.

columns.name: timing_first_frame
columns.definition: 41 for static-final; 1/33/65 for frame-32/48/96.

columns.name: timing_last_frame
columns.definition: 128 for static-final; 32/64/96 for frame-32/48/96.

columns.name: region
columns.definition: Always full; this table excludes ROI rows.

columns.name: independent_method_seeds
columns.definition: Count copied from paired-differences.csv seeds; all values are 3.

columns.name: reference_policy
columns.definition: Condition-derived label; Bistro fixed sample seed1001/262144 precision not evaluated, Cornell/Arcade retained dual-stream precision accepted.

columns.definition: Copy of smape_mean from summary.csv matching method pdf-off; mean or sample SD across 3 independent method seeds.
